title: Literal for a previous gate
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and $g$ gates, let $i$ be a gate position, let $j$ index a position strictly before $i$, and choose a required sign. The associated literal on the $n+g$ coordinates uses the coordinate assigned by the circuit's previous-gate indexing operation for $(i,j)$ and has that required sign.
caveat: The definition of the previous-gate indexing operation is absent from the supplied formal statement, so its precise selection rule cannot be stated.
